_comment: Committed counter for Lloyd's Row-1 sanity test correlation IDs. Bumped automatically by `npm run lloyds:sanity:prepare` (persists the id you're about to paste) and by `npm run lloyds:sanity:send-xml` (once SPN has Service Bus Sender). Format: 0000-0000-0000-NNNNN (range 03000–99999, avoids the 00000–02999 band used by manual tests). Successful landings: 03004 = AAIE EU-167668 (record 01712, Approved), 03005 = AACA CA-6178 (record 01725, plan-driven).
